The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside…
Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.
But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad…
The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together…
Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed…

Yahweh’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of…

people.name: Aphek
people.line: A city in the Shephelah, site of Philistine battles.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A town in Judah, home of David's wife Ahinoam

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.
translations.bsb: Now the Philistines brought all their forces together at Aphek, while Israel camped by the spring in Jezreel.
translations.kjv: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.
translations.asv: Now the Philistines gathered together all their hosts to Aphek: and the Israelites encamped by the fountain which is in Jezreel.
